info.title: Wagyu Consumer API
info.description: Public HTTP contract for building a Wagyu swap and native-bridge client. Order IDs are not credentials; retain the returned session ID privately. WebSocket updates are documented separately because REST remains the durable source of truth.

orderSession.name: x-session-id
orderSession.description: Owner credential returned when an order is created. Keep it private and send it only in this header, never in a URL.

destinationProof.name: verify
destinationProof.description: Read-only proof for one order: its exact destination address. Missing or invalid proof intentionally returns the same 404 as a missing order.

integratorKey.name: x-integrator-key
integratorKey.description: Optional integration credential. It does not unlock the API — quoting, creating and tracking all work without it. It attributes the order to your integration, collects your integrator fee, and is what permits a caller-supplied sessionId at creation. A confidential (server-side) key may also end the deposit wait of the orders created by its own integration. `x-api-key` is accepted as an alias; a key in the query string is refused even when valid, so a credential can never reach a proxy log. Sending no key is anonymous, never an error. A key that is present but invalid, revoked, or belongs to a suspended integration is refused with 401 on every route rather than silently downgraded to anonymous, and that 401 carries the generic unauthorized body — the reason stays in our logs.

put.summary: Submit a coinflip decision for an eligible order

round.description: The pending round this decision answers. A stale decision is rejected, never applied to a later round.

accept.description: Whether to take the offered flip. false cashes the bonus out instead. Omission is never treated as a decline — the field is required.

clientSeed.description: Your half of the provably-fair seed. The outcome is HMAC(serverSeed, clientSeed), and SHA256(serverSeed) is committed before you choose it. Omit to let the engine use a fallback seed.

side.description: Which band wins. It selects the winning range only and never feeds the HMAC, so it cannot change the drawn number.

stakeAtomic.description: Coinflip TABLE only: the bet for this round, in the asset's smallest unit. Proposed, not binding — the engine refuses a bet above your balance, below the minimum, or beyond the pool's exposure cap, and leaves the round open so you can correct it. Ignored by the in-swap bonus, which always stakes the whole delivery.
